messages:
noah_csm: Noticing MicroBurstInc onboarding sees p99 ~900ms for single-turn short chats (<50 tokens). p95 is fine but UX needs stable sub-300ms. Idea: session-affinity + route short sessions to compact-3b-int4 + enable early-exit for short prompts and tighten batching to 10ms. Thoughts?

ops_bot: alert: customer=MicroBurstInc window=08:40-09:10 p99=0.91s p95=0.27s spike=2.8x

tara_success: Customer prioritizes consistency over absolute perf. They're okay with occasional small quality diffs. Can we limit canary to sessions with avg prompt <60 tokens?

priya_eng: Yes. Plan: session-affinity filter that pins sessions after first 3 short requests. Route weights: 80% standard-7b, 20% compact-3b-int4 for pinned short sessions. Spillover to standard-3b if compact queues. Collect per-session CDF, sample QA, tokenization diffs.

zane_infra: I will add infra guard: auto-spill if queue_latency>150ms or GPU_util>78%. Enable prefix KV caching for session repeats.

kevin_sre: Log variant placement reasons for postmortem. Schedule canary for 3 hours during low churn.

priya_eng: Deploying canary config now (snippet):
```json
{
  "customer":"microburstinc",
  "route_policy":"session_affinity_filter",
  "session_thresholds":{"short_tokens_max":60,"seed_requests":3},
  "variants":[{"model":"standard-7b","weight":80},{"model":"compact-3b-int4","weight":20,"spillover":"standard-3b"}],
  "batching":{"max_delay_ms":10},
  "cache":{"prefix_kv":true}
}
```

noah_csm: Rollback criteria: sampled QA fail >1.5% or session p99 worsens >10% vs baseline. Capture 50 golden sessions for manual review.

priya_eng: Canary started 06:00 UTC. After 45m: short-session median -24%, p95 -30%, p99 -18%, cache_hit 37%, spillovers 3.2%, no errors.

ops_bot: canary update: 45m window short_session p50=-24% p95=-30% p99=-18% cache_hit=37% spillovers=3.2%

tara_success: I'll ping the customer with the canary link and ask for a quick UX sniff test set.

priya_eng: Canary wrapped at 09:00 UTC. Automated eval: quality delta -0.6% (within threshold). Cost sim: ~28% unit savings for short-heavy traffic. PASS.

noah_csm: Updating onboarding doc with recommended policy and Console steps to enable session-affinity and spillover. Looping in renewal team to highlight cost and UX improvements. Scheduling a 1-week health check A/B to track retention signals. Closing thread and attaching canary dashboard + eval export to customer record. :rocket:
